name: VIRTUS Wustermark campus
summary: VIRTUS Data Centres, part of ST Telemedia Global Data Centres, is developing a EUR 3 billion data center megacampus on more than 35 hectares in Wustermark, Havelland, about 12 km from Berlin's city limits. The campus is planned for up to nine data centers and 204 MW of IT load, with an initial 300 MW of power delivered through a dedicated substation with dual direct connections to the 50Hertz 380 kV grid, the first such connection for a Berlin-Brandenburg data center campus. Two 185 MVA super-grid transformers had been installed by June 2026; VIRTUS now projects operations from early 2028.
